errors.evidence: The description fails to explain what each of the two lines represents, omitting the information from the legend. The blue line is "БДС на един зает по текущи цени" (GVA per employed person at current prices) and the orange line is "БДС на един зает по цени на 2015 г." (GVA per employed person at 2015 prices).
The value for the blue line in 2018 is 25356.0, not 26017.2. The value 26017.2 corresponds to the orange line in 2017.

errors.text_span: Вижда се лек спад между 2010 и 2011
errors.evidence: The blue line shows an increase between 2010 (15819.9) and 2011 (18329.6), not a decrease ("спад").
The value for the orange line in 2018 is 25356.0, not 27338.8. The value 27338.8 corresponds to the blue line in 2017.

errors.text_span: Най-ниската стойност на оранжевата линия е 16016.3 за 2002.
errors.evidence: The lowest value for the orange line is its starting point in 2000, which is 14300.4. The value 16016.3 is the data point for the year 2002, not the minimum value of the series.
